verdict.rationale: Missive's own marketing says teams can "collaborate behind the scenes" on conversations, and a community user says they choose Missive to "collaborate directly in a thread" rather than adding everyone to a box. Neither source explicitly documents internal comments or @mentions placed beside an email, so only the general side-thread idea is supported; the separate team chat and co-writing features do not count toward the comment thread itself. Missing for 10: explicit docs for internal comments attached to an email conversation, @mention notifications, evidence that this replaces forwarding, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around

citations.quote: See what’s going on, know who’s doing what, and collaborate behind the scenes — without changing your workflow.
they want to collaborate directly in a thread, as Missive's collaborative writing allows
